title: Windows 98 Desktop Experience
description:
Wallpaper for imitating the Windows 98 desktop experience

This wallpaper includes Windows 98's Channel Bar, the startup sound, a music visualizer, a lyrics viewer, a web browser, and various apps like paint, solitaire, clock, and calculator.

Some web pages won't behave correctly because of the iframe security restrictions.

Right click this wallpaper and click 'Open in Explorer' to view the source code and the license (MIT.)

Visit WinClassic to learn how to get the classic theme on modern Windows.

Source code: https://github.com/Ingan121/ModernActiveDesktop
